name: Pure Bologna fresco
style: The WHOLE screen is a medieval wall fresco by Giovanni da Modena (Inferno, Bolognini Chapel, Bologna, c.1410): matte tempera on lime plaster, flat areas of earth pigment, firm reddish-brown sinopia contours, naive flattened perspective, figures painted like the fresco's devils and damned, plaster texture and slight cracks, light overall value (a lit wall, not a dark render). Palette ONLY: lime white, yellow ochre, red ochre, sinopia, burnt umber, slate grey-blue, bone black. HUD painted as a fresco border band with a painted portrait medallion.

name: Pure 1930s cel animation (Cuphead technique)
style: Pure 1930s hand-inked cel animation look like the game Cuphead, but grim horror: thick, even, slightly wobbly black ink lines on characters and weapon, flat cel colours with one soft shadow tone, lush hand-painted watercolour backgrounds behind with NO ink lines, sepia film grain, light vignette, soft old-film colour. Demons drawn as nightmarish 1930s cartoon devils (Fleischer/Disney 'Hell's Bells'), not cute. Palette: warm sepia, cream, brick red, mustard, teal-grey, black ink. HUD like a vintage title card frame.

name: Fusion: inked figures on a painted fresco world
style: Strict two-layer fusion: EVERYTHING that matters (demons, blood, shotgun, hands, HUD, portrait) is drawn in 1930s ink-and-cel technique with thick black outlines and flat cel colour; the WORLD (walls, pillars, floor, sky, the wall fresco) is painted like a faded medieval fresco by Giovanni da Modena with NO outlines, low contrast, pale lime-plaster and ochre tones. The contrast between the crisp inked foreground and the soft painted background is the whole point. Palette: fresco background in lime white, ochre, slate, sinopia; foreground adds black ink, bone white, dark madder red for blood.

name: Woodcut / Doré engraving + one red
style: A black-and-white woodcut / steel engraving like Gustave Doré's Inferno illustrations and Dürer's woodcuts: everything built from black hatching and cross-hatching on aged paper, strong value design, no greys except through hatching. ONE accent colour only: deep blood red, used for blood, the muzzle flash and the health number. HUD as an engraved frame with an engraved portrait.

name: Illuminated manuscript (Pentiment-like)
style: A medieval illuminated manuscript page come alive: vellum-coloured ground, flat gouache colours, crisp black pen outlines, burnished gold leaf for the HUD frame and haloes of fire, decorative borders, figures in the stylised manner of 14th-15th century Italian book painting of hell. Palette: vellum cream, ultramarine, vermilion, verdigris green, gold, black ink.

name: Dark limited-palette pixel art (Blasphemous-like)
style: High-end hand-pixelled dark pixel art like the game Blasphemous, rendered in first person at a low resolution (about 480x270 upscaled with crisp pixels): a strict 24-colour palette, deep black backgrounds, strong rim light on figures, Spanish-baroque religious horror, gold and crimson accents, very deliberate pixel clusters, no dithering noise. Palette: blacks, cold dark greys, bone, gold ochre, crimson, a cold teal accent.

name: Classic 1993 Doom pixel look with fresco palette
style: Authentic early-90s software-rendered FPS look like DOOM (1993): chunky low-res pixels (320x200 feel, upscaled sharp), 256-colour palette, digitised-painting sprites, flat-lit textures, the classic grey stone HUD bar replaced by a carved stone bar with a Doom-style face in the middle. Palette restricted to earthy fresco colours: browns, ochres, brick reds, greys, bone; muzzle flash bright yellow.

name: Gothic stained glass
style: The whole screen looks like a gothic stained-glass window: every shape is a flat piece of coloured glass separated by thick black lead lines, light shining through, jewel colours, faces and demons painted on the glass with brown grisaille lines. Strong readability through the lead lines. Palette: deep ruby, cobalt blue, emerald, amber, white glass, black lead.

name: Mignola / Darkest Dungeon heavy shadow
style: Comic-book style of Mike Mignola (Hellboy) and the game Darkest Dungeon: huge flat black shadow shapes, very few lines, figures defined by black masses with small lit planes, gothic and oppressive, slightly textured paper. Palette: black, one dull ochre-bone light tone, one desaturated stone grey, and blood red as the only strong colour.

name: Grisaille (Giotto stone painting) + blood red
style: Grisaille painting like Giotto's Virtues and Vices in the Scrovegni Chapel: the entire world, demons and weapon painted in shades of warm stone grey as if carved in marble relief, modelled with soft light, set into a painted architectural frame. The ONLY colour is red: blood, the muzzle flash, the banner and the health number. Very calm, very readable, eerie.

name: Silent horror film (1920s sepia, Häxan / Nosferatu)
style: A frame from a 1920s silent horror film (Häxan 1922, Nosferatu): sepia-toned monochrome, theatrical stage-set hell with painted backdrops, practical-effect demons, heavy film grain, scratches and gate weave, iris vignette, a black intertitle-style HUD frame with Art Nouveau ornament. Palette: sepia browns, cream, black, a hand-tinted red only for blood and fire.

name: Bosch oil panel (Garden of Earthly Delights, hell wing)
style: Painted like the hell wing of Hieronymus Bosch's Garden of Earthly Delights: oil on panel, dark night background with distant burning buildings, small precise glowing details, pale bodies, grotesque hybrid demons made of animals and objects, thin precise outlines, glazed colour. Palette: near-black blue-green night, fiery orange-red glow, pale flesh, ochre, muted greens.
